verdict.rationale: QuickBooks documents direct bank/credit card/PayPal/Square connections that auto-import and match transactions, an 800+ app integration ecosystem (Shopify, Amazon Business, PayPal), and payroll AI that pulls time/attendance data to run payroll, all flowing into the ledger automatically. This is corroborated by community mentions of automatic bank rules and PayPal export/import into QuickBooks. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of payroll auto-sync specifically and any friction reports about bank-feed reliability beyond general community complaints about cost/quality.
